seo.title: Table Reservation System for Restaurants — Online Booking | IQ Rest
seo.description: Let guests book tables directly from your website. Automatic or manual confirmation, email notifications, and full calendar management — all included.

hero.title: Accept Table Bookings 24/7 from Your Website
hero.subtitle: Guests pick a date, time, and party size — and book instantly. You manage everything from your dashboard, no phone calls needed.
hero.noCreditCard: No credit card required. Free plan available.

features.title: How Table Reservations Work
features.subtitle: Two steps from guest request to confirmed booking.

items.title: Guests Book from Your Website
items.description: Customers visit your restaurant page, tap 'Reserve a Table', choose a date and time, enter their details, and submit. No app needed — works in any browser on any device.

items.title: You Manage Bookings in Your Dashboard
items.description: Every reservation appears in your dashboard with guest name, phone, party size, date, and notes. Confirm or decline with one tap. Set automatic confirmation or review each booking manually.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about table reservations.

items.question: Do customers need to create an account to book?
items.answer: No. Guests simply fill in their name, phone number, party size, and preferred time. No account or app download required.

items.question: Can I set available time slots and capacity?
items.answer: Yes. Define your working hours, reservation slot duration, and table capacity. The system only shows available slots to guests.

items.question: Will I get notified when someone books?
items.answer: Yes. You receive an email for every new reservation. Guests also get a confirmation email once you approve the booking.

items.question: Can I use both automatic and manual confirmation?
items.answer: Yes. Choose automatic mode to confirm bookings instantly based on availability, or manual mode to review and approve each request yourself.
